adjudicated.ruling: The approved Benziger printing sets an acute on the disyllable (Scríptum, p. 106), a slip: the same page prints Scriptum est enim without it, and the edition leaves two-syllable words unaccented (ORTHOGRAPHY rule 4).
The lexical accent is restored in the working text under the edition's house convention; the witness's capital typography is recorded exactly.
